design.quote: This randomized, controlled, monocentric parallel-group trial

population.quote: participants living with T2D, body mass index >27 kg/m2, HbA1c ≥53 mmol/mol (≥7.0%) and ≤86 mmol/mol (≤10.0%) and without insulin therapy
population.value: adults with type 2 diabetes, overweight/obesity, HbA1c 7.0-10.0%, BMI >27 kg/m2, not on insulin

intervention.quote: Participants are equally and randomly allocated to one of four study groups: (1) intermittent energy restriction group, (2) exercise group, (3) combined intermittent energy restriction and exercise group and (4) control group
intervention.value: intermittent energy restriction, exercise, combined intermittent energy restriction and exercise, control group

follow_up.quote: followed by a two-year follow-up phase
